not_read: current or fallback M7_sol Eccl chunk map

web_mt_versification_hold.mapping: WEB 5:1 corresponds to MT/OSHB 4:17; WEB 5:2-20 correspond to MT/OSHB 5:1-19.
web_mt_versification_hold.decision: Retain WEB coordinates for canonical coverage and keep WEB 5:1-7 as one worship-and-vow movement. The MT/English chapter displacement is evidence only and cannot select a seam or preferred numbering system.

hebrew_textual_inventory_evidence_only.guard: OSHB and UXLC are correlated WLC-family witnesses, not independent votes. Lemmas, roots, morphology, accents, paragraph marks, qere/ketiv and numbering are evidence only; none independently authorizes meaning, voice, reading or boundary.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: superscription introducing the words of Qohelet
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: The verbless title identifies the ensuing words and is followed by the programmatic hebel declaration.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Qohelet is grammatically marked yet used as a designation; translation choices such as Preacher, Teacher or Convener and the son-of-David/king wording do not settle identity, gender, authorship or frame voice.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: The title formula supports a formal seam only; it does not reconstruct a historical speaker.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: programmatic hebel declaration and cyclical-cosmos opening poem
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: The doubled hebel formula opens a patterned sequence of generation, sun, wind, streams, weariness, recurrence and forgotten former things.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Hebel and yitron in 1:2-3 establish recurring lexical questions, while participial and cyclical language binds 1:4-11; no single English gloss exhausts either term.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: Recurring roots and poetic parallelism are evidence for cohesion, not a doctrine or fixed glossary.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: first-person royal wisdom investigation
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: The explicit first-person royal self-presentation and giving of the heart launch an investigation that closes with the wisdom/grief saying.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: I Qohelet was king, under-the-heavens language, crooked/lacking sayings and wisdom/knowledge vocabulary mark a discrete inquiry, but do not identify the speaker historically.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: First-person grammar supports discourse tracking only.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: pleasure, achievement and possession experiment
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: I said in my heart initiates a catalogue of pleasure, projects, wealth and greatness, followed by the backward-looking assessment in 2:11.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Repeated first-person verbs and list syntax bind experiment to assessment; hebel, wind-chasing and yitron recur without fixing their English senses.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: Catalogue form supports cohesion, not biography or moral verdict.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: comparative reflection on wisdom, folly and common death
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: I turned to see resets the investigation; comparison culminates in the shared fate and consequent hatred-of-life statement.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Seeing/turning formula, comparative yitron language and the refrain-like hebel/wind conclusion distinguish this movement.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: The lexical contrast does not authorize a systematic anthropology or ethics.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: toil, successor and enjoyment conclusion
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Hatred of toil opens the successor problem; rhetorical questions lead to the first extended eating, drinking, portion and divine-gift conclusion.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Amal, heleq and gift/enjoyment vocabulary connect problem and conclusion; their recurrence later makes 2:24-26 a conclusion within the movement, not an isolated maxim.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: The refrain is boundary evidence only and does not settle providence or moral theology.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: paired-time poem
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: An opening everything/season assertion governs fourteen antithetical time pairs with repeated infinitival phrasing.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Et and repeated le- infinitives produce a bounded poetic register; individual pairs remain inside the governing whole.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: The list form supports one poem, not a deterministic chronology or ethical authorization.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: work, appointed time and enjoyment reflection
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: The yitron question resumes reflection on task, beautiful/in-its-time wording and the unsearchable whole, then closes with enjoyment/gift and recurrence.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: The notoriously broad 3:11 term often rendered eternity/world is syntactically embedded in the work/time reflection; it must not be isolated or lexically totalized.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: No translation or theology of 3:11 is selected.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: injustice, judgment, human-animal mortality and enjoyment reflection
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Moreover I saw opens the justice observation; I said in my heart develops testing and common breath/dust before the concluding portion question.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Ruach in 3:21 and interrogative syntax generate major translation pressure; the dust/breath comparison and enjoyment conclusion remain one observation movement.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: Do not infer an afterlife doctrine or preferred rendering from morphology alone.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: oppression observation and threefold comparative lament
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: I returned and saw opens an oppression scene; repeated no-comforter wording leads to the living/dead/not-yet-born comparison.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Shuv plus ra'ah marks a reset, while comparative forms bind the lament; ra'ah/evil vocabulary does not carry one automatic English or theological sense.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: The lament form does not authorize a doctrine of death or nonexistence.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: toil, envy, isolation and companionship saying movement
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: A toil/envy observation proceeds through folded-hands and one-hand sayings into the solitary laborer, then answers isolation with the two/three companionship chain.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: OSHB marks qere/ketiv pressure at 4:8; repeated one/two vocabulary and better-than sayings support the movement without resolving the variant as boundary authority.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: The numerical progression is rhetorical evidence, not a universal social prescription.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: poor wise youth and old foolish king reversal
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: A better-than saying introduces a royal succession vignette that runs through the final no-rejoicing assessment.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Pronoun and participant tracking is compressed; the royal terms and comparative opening define a vignette but do not identify rulers or chronology.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: No historical reconstruction is selected.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: temple approach, guarded speech and vow admonition
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Guard your foot at the house of God opens a sustained imperative sequence about hearing, speech, dreams, vows and fear, closing with the fear-God injunction.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: WEB 5:1 equals MT/OSHB 4:17, where OSHB marks qere/ketiv pressure; WEB 5:2-7 equals MT 5:1-6. Imperatives and shared cultic-speech vocabulary override neither numbering system but preserve one discourse movement.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: Versification and qere/ketiv are recorded without choosing a preferred reading or manufacturing a seam.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: hierarchy, wealth, consumption and grievous-loss observations
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: The oppression/higher-official observation moves into a chain on money, consumers, sleep, hoarded riches and naked departure, ending with darkness and vexation.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Compressed administrative syntax at 5:8-9 and OSHB qere/ketiv pressure at WEB 5:9 and 5:11 lower confidence; repeated wealth/eating vocabulary binds the movement.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: No political economy or moral system is inferred.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: enjoyment/gift conclusion and wealth-without-enjoyment counterexample
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Behold, what I have seen as good opens a portion/gift conclusion; chapter 6's there-is-an-evil counterexample reverses the same wealth, honor, gift and enjoyment vocabulary and closes with the shared grave.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: WEB 5:18 contains OSHB's MT 5:17 qere/ketiv pressure. Heleq, gift and eating/enjoyment vocabulary create an explicit cross-chapter positive/counterexample pair.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: The contrast supports cohesion without settling divine agency, prosperity or afterlife.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: appetite, advantage, named limits and unknown-future questions
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: All labor-for-mouth begins a compact chain of appetite and better-than sayings, moving to what-has-been-named and closing with paired who-knows questions.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: OSHB marks qere/ketiv at 6:10; yitron, knowing and naming language bind the questions but do not authorize deterministic or divine-dispute conclusions.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: No preferred variant or philosophical system is selected.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: linked better-than sayings on name, death, rebuke, patience and providential limits
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: A repeated tov...min comparative chain governs mourning, rebuke, ending/beginning and patience, then turns to consider-the-work and good/adversity closure.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Comparative syntax and wisdom vocabulary support a chain larger than individual sayings; rare/compressed clauses resist one-to-one English equivalence.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: The chain is not converted into isolated doctrines or universal prescriptions.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: observation and counsel on righteousness, wickedness, wisdom and overheard speech
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: In my hebel-days I saw introduces paired anomalies, followed by the disputed do-not-be-overmuch counsel, a holding-both conclusion and warning about servants' curses.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: The paired prohibitions and 7:18 holding formula must remain in context; OSHB qere/ketiv at 7:22 and semantic range of righteous/wicked/wisdom lower confidence.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: Do not derive a moderation ethic, righteousness verdict or preferred reading.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: wisdom investigation, elusive reckoning and human-relations conclusion
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: All this I tested by wisdom and I turned...to know launch an inquiry that reaches a this-alone-I-found conclusion at 7:29.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: The difficult woman/man language, counting syntax and singular/plural forms in 7:26-29 are embedded in an explicit investigation frame.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: No gender verdict, misogynistic universalization, speaker reconstruction or moral doctrine is authorized.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: wisdom question and royal-command counsel
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: The who-is-like-the-wise question leads into imperative royal conduct, time/judgment limits and an I-saw closure concerning human rule.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Compressed syntax, command vocabulary and repeated time/judgment terms support a counsel unit but do not identify a regime or authorize political theology.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: Royal language is discourse evidence only.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: burial/forgetting observation, delayed justice, enjoyment and unsearchability conclusion
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Then I saw in 8:10 opens a textually difficult observation; because-sentence reasoning develops delayed sentence and apparent reversal before commendation of joy and final inability-to-find refrain.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: 8:10 has difficult syntax and lexical/textual interpretation (buried, came/went, holy place, forgotten/praised); it remains inside the observation-to-unsearchability movement.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: No emendation, retribution scheme or preferred rendering is selected.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: common-fate reflection and imperative enjoyment exhortation
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: All this I laid to heart opens the righteous/wise and one-fate reflection; while-alive contrast leads directly to go/eat/drink/enjoy/work imperatives, closing with no work in Sheol.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: OSHB marks qere/ketiv at 9:4. The knowing/not-knowing, memory, love/hate and Sheol terms in 9:5-10 are semantically and theologically pressured but rhetorically joined to the life/enjoyment exhortation.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: Do not make 9:5-10 a complete afterlife doctrine or choose a variant.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: chance observation and poor-wise-man city example
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: I returned and saw introduces race/battle/bread/riches/favor reversals and time/chance; this wisdom I also saw introduces an illustrative city story ending with wisdom-versus-weapons.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Gam-zo linking and repeated wisdom vocabulary connect observation and example, though memory/hearing language and the final sinner clause remain translation-sensitive.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: No theory of chance, providence or historical identification is authorized.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: folly sayings and ruler/servant reversal
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Dead-flies analogy opens linked folly/wisdom sayings; ruler anger and an I-have-seen evil observation culminate in servants on horses and princes walking.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: OSHB qere/ketiv at 10:3 and directional heart imagery resist literalized English mapping; folly and office/rank vocabulary still bind the movement.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: No political hierarchy or lexicalized left/right doctrine is inferred.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: hazard, skill and fool-speech proverb chain
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: A sequence of pit, wall, stone, wood and blunt-iron hazards turns through wisdom's advantage to serpent and speech, ending with the fool's wearying labor and ignorance.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: OSHB qere/ketiv at 10:10 and terse syntax lower confidence; chained conditional/participial forms and wisdom/advantage language support the larger saying sequence.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: Individual proverbs remain contextual evidence, not isolated universal rules.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: ruler, feast, laziness, money and guarded-speech sayings
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Woe/blessed land sayings govern a court-and-household chain, closing with the repeated do-not-curse warning and winged-report image.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: OSHB marks qere/ketiv at 10:20; parallel king/prince clauses and speech/curse repetition support cohesion without resolving social application.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: No regime, class ethic or surveillance doctrine is authorized.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: risk, distribution and diligent-sowing exhortation
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Send your bread and give portions open imperatives about uncertain disaster; cloud/wind observations lead to morning/evening sowing under repeated not-knowing.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: 11:1's shalah/bread/waters idiom and 11:5's wind-spirit/bones-in-the-womb language permit multiple contextual renderings; repeated uncertainty and imperatives bind the unit.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: Do not select trade, charity, magical practice or embryological doctrine as the exclusive reading.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: youth-and-aging exhortation and hebel closure
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Light-is-sweet and rejoice/remember imperatives lead across 12:1 into the sustained aging/dissolution poem ending with dust/spirit language and hebel-of-hebel at 12:8.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: 12:1 has famous lexical/textual pressure around remember your Creator(s)/youth, and OSHB marks qere/ketiv at 12:6. Imperatives, before-not-yet temporal repetition and the aging-house imagery bind the cross-chapter movement.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: Do not choose a reading of 12:1, decode every aging image, or settle dust/spirit and afterlife theology.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: third-person Qohelet evaluation and closing epilogue
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Moreover, Qohelet was wise shifts into third-person evaluation of teaching and word-making; the end-of-the-matter formula in 12:13 and judgment clause in 12:14 close the epilogue and book.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Third-person syntax, teaching/collecting/writing vocabulary and the sof-davar closing formula supply positive local form evidence; they do not identify an editor or reconstruct compositional history.
proposed_chunks.evidence_only_guard: Preserve the frame-voice shift without assigning authorship or settling fear, judgment, canon or theology.

exact_parent_alternatives_and_low_holds.hold: Preserve the complete royal investigation parent over 1:12-18, 2:1-11, 2:12-17 and 2:18-26; enjoyment remains a conclusion inside the experiment.
Preserve the work/time/injustice/mortality parent; do not isolate 3:11 or 3:21 as doctrine.
Preserve the four-observation parent over oppression, toil/companionship and royal reversal.
WEB 5:1 equals MT 4:17; retain the complete worship/vow exhortation across the numbering displacement.
Preserve the wealth, enjoyment/gift, appetite and unknown-future parent across the chapter seam.
Preserve the larger better-sayings and wisdom-investigation discourse; keep 7:16-18 and 7:26-29 contextual and LOW.
Preserve royal counsel plus justice/enjoyment/unsearchability parent; 8:10 remains textually unresolved.
Preserve common fate, enjoyment, chance, wisdom example and folly/ruler sayings as a larger discourse parent.
Preserve risk, diligence, youth, remembering and aging as the pre-epilogue final movement; do not detach 12:1.
Preserve the exact epilogue alternative and its third-person frame shift; no speaker/editor reconstruction.
